'''Revised A New Hope''' is the 15th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in September 1998. It is the white-border Revised Unlimited reprint of [[A New Hope Limited]]. CardGuide numbering: 15th product.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

It reprints the 162-card Limited pool. Most cards use Special Edition–era revised text (for example, "Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots" in place of "Adds 2 to the power of any starship he pilots"). The unique-card list is on [[A New Hope Limited]].<ref name="encyc" />

== Packaging ==
Sold in 9-card booster packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) and 30-pack boxes. Each box included a fold-out Rules Supplement.<ref name="encyc" />
